shared_analysis.analysis_rationale: The patch adds an explicit guard `if (lh.line_range == 0) goto line_fail;` immediately before arithmetic that divides by `lh.line_range` in the `DW_LNS_const_add_pc` case inside `bfd/dwarf2.c`. This is concrete evidence that malformed DWARF line header data could set `line_range` to zero and trigger division by zero during line program parsing.
